limits: The observation path requires the existing form-level observer in each potentially same-named descendant. Unique native pointers/public editor identities can prove ownership without it.
List subforms, hierarchy, physical Intel hardware and remote client/server delivery remain separate gates.
Built-in native message dialog and AreaList supplementary-Unicode vendor limitations remain documented.
